summary: Your reports now rest only on complete data, and updates run more reliably.

fixes.title: Reports use only complete data
fixes.text: When a data collection is incomplete, it no longer replaces your good history. You never see or receive incomplete data.

fixes.title: Updates finish reliably
fixes.text: Long updates are no longer stopped by mistake. Every part of SecurityInsight now moves to the new version together.

fixes.title: You see when sending is paused
fixes.text: When sending data to your other systems is paused because the newest data was incomplete, SecurityInsight now tells you, and since when.

fixes.title: No repeated runs or mails
fixes.text: A step that already ran is no longer started a second time, so you get no repeated mails or data.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Mail waits safely when Microsoft cannot confirm the mailbox. Finished runs show as finished. Update logs are complete, and the identity collection is quicker again.
